changes: No substantive changes. Notes now say the colophon breaks off after 'likhitā mayā . .', so a scribe's name or date may have been lost.

notes: The scribe is not named ('likhitā mayā'). The colophon breaks off after it ('. . ///'), so a scribe's name, date or place may have been lost or not quoted. 'śivavarmmāṛtiṃ (!)' is probably a corruption of 'śivavarmakṛtiṃ', i.e. the work of Śivavarman (author). 'kālajñānacchāyācakraṃ' is a section title, not a person.
